turns.text: Fortunately, yes. I'm actually on my lunch break now, heating up some of the extra food I packed from last night's dinner.

turns.text: Just a quiet night tonight, but we're hoping to go out salsa dancing this Friday if we both have the energy.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a blast! It's been a little while. Have you had any time for your sourdough baking lately?

turns.text: Not this week yet. I need to feed my starter tonight so I can hopefully bake a fresh loaf on my day off.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A fresh warm loaf of sourdough is always worth the effort. Well, I'll let you get back to your lunch and your shift!

turns.speaker: user
